map.宫高腹围与胎儿体重(Hadlock)计算器，用B超四参数(BPD/HC/AC/F: The calculator estimates fetal weight with the BPD/HC/AC/FL Hadlock formula and the fundal-height/girth method. A professional medical tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
map.Hadlock 四参数（Hadlock 1985, Am J Obstet Gy: Hadlock four-parameter (Hadlock 1985, Am J Obstet Gynecol 151:333): EFW (g) = 10^(1.3596 − 0.00386·AC·FL + 0.0064·HC + 0.00061·BPD·AC + 0.0424·AC + 0.174·FL); when HC is missing use the Hadlock three-parameter formula (BPD+AC+FL, Hadlock C 1985, same reference): 10^(1.335 − 0.0034·AC·FL + 0.0316·BPD + 0.0457·AC + 0.1623·FL); with only AC+FL use the Hadlock two-parameter formula (Hadlock 1985): 10^(1.304 + 0.05281·AC + 0.1938·FL − 0.004·AC·FL); with only BPD+AC use Shepard 1982: 10^(−1.7492 + 0.166·BPD + 0.046·AC − 2.646·AC·BPD/1000) (the original formula is in kg, ×1000 → g). All log₁₀ above are base 10, lengths in cm and EFW in g. The fundal height/abdominal circumference tab uses an empirical formula: EFW (g) = 2900 + 0.3·fundal height·abdominal circumference; Johnson method (not engaged n=12): EFW (g) = (fundal height − 12)·155.
map.B 超参数越全越准：四参数（BPD+HC+AC+FL）优先；缺 HC 用 Had: The more complete the ultrasound parameters the more accurate: four parameters (BPD+HC+AC+FL) first; without HC use the Hadlock three-parameter formula (BPD+AC+FL); with only AC+FL use the Hadlock two-parameter formula; with only BPD+AC use the Shepard two-parameter formula. Note that the original Shepard formula is in kg, so treating it as g would inflate the result 1000-fold; the code multiplies by 1000 explicitly. With a single parameter (e.g. only AC or only FL) no pseudo-formula estimate is made and the page reports insufficient parameters. The fundal height/abdominal circumference tab is a bedside empirical formula: 2900 + 0.3·fundal height·abdominal circumference and the Johnson method (fundal height − 12)·155 (n=12 means not engaged; 11 is often used when engaged). An estimated weight ≥ 4000 g is macrosomia.
map.临床触诊宫高与腹围，简易估算（误差常达数百克）: Bedside estimate from clinically palpated fundal height and abdominal circumference (errors often reach several hundred grams)

map.BPD + AC + FL（三参数，缺 HC）— Hadlock C 1985（: BPD + AC + FL (three parameters, HC missing) — Hadlock C 1985 (same reference)
map.AC + FL（Hadlock 两参数）— Hadlock 1985（同上文献）: AC + FL (Hadlock two parameters) — Hadlock 1985 (same reference)
map.BPD + AC（Shepard 两参数，仅有 BPD+AC 时）— Shepa: BPD + AC (Shepard two parameters, when only BPD+AC are available) — Shepard 1982, Am J Obstet Gynecol 142:47
log₁₀(EFW/kg) = -1.7492 + 0.166×BPD + 0.046×AC - 2.646×(AC×BPD)/1000; lengths in cm, the original formula outputs kg and this tool multiplies by 1000 to convert to g
map.宫高 × 腹围（床旁经验式，非回归发表式）: Fundal height × abdominal circumference (bedside empirical formula, not a published regression)
map.EFW(g) = 2900 + 0.3 × 宫高(cm) × 腹围(cm)（足月: EFW (g) = 2900 + 0.3 × fundal height (cm) × abdominal circumference (cm) (rough estimate near term; bedside reference only, errors often reach several hundred grams)
map.EFW(g) = (宫高 − n) × 155；未入盆 n=12，入盆 n=11: EFW (g) = (fundal height − n) × 155; n=12 when not engaged and n=11 when engaged (this tool always uses n=12 for the not-engaged case)

Curran, MD) returns 3102 g for its Hadlock 1 (AC+FL) and 3123 g for Hadlock 2 (BPD+AC+FL) with the same inputs, a relative error <0.1%.
